services.name: fishing charter
services.desc: Our custom fishing charters are based upon your preference. Whether you would like to fish for Salmon, Pacific Ling, Rockfish, Spot Prawns, crabs or a combination we can tailor a day just for you. We can accommodate a maximum of 8 people. For larger groups we can do separate charters. Departure is from the Madeira Park Govt dock. Getting here from Vancouver entails a ferry ride from Horseshoe Bay to Langdale. Drive north along Hwy 101 through Gibsons, Sechelt and on to Pender Harbour. Turn left into Madeira Park, through the village and then right to the Govt Dock. The Gulf Rascal is moored at the first float. Dress for the weather. A rain coat and boots might not be a bad idea even though

explain.meaning: A long trip, usually around eight hours.

includes: Use of commercial fishing equipment for spot prawn fishing
blurb: Guests join charters aboard the Gulf Rascal for sport fishing, spot prawn fishing, and eco-tours in the Sunshine Coast and Pender Harbour area. Fishing includes salmon, ling cod, flounders, rockfish, and spot prawns with hands-on experience pulling prawn traps. Eco-tours include scenic wildlife and bird-watching cruises in local straits and inlets.
